the song system is sexually dimorphic in BDNF expression, and that BDNF expression is regulated by sex steroids, and that this expression changes across development in ways consistent with a potential role in song system development and/or song learning.

BDNF protein is differentially expressed in male and female zebra finches in a developmentally regulated manner in the song nuclei, and that this pattern of expression is consistent with a role of BDNF in the maturation of the song system.
